name: ODRL_Policies_Bench
description: A benchmark of ODRL (Open Digital Rights Language) policy statements and corresponding representations intended to evaluate models' ability to parse, classify, or generate formal policy expressions from natural language. It measures accuracy in mapping NL policy descriptions to ODRL constructs and in understanding policy constraints and permissions.
evaluation_method: exact_match for generated policy scripts and F1/accuracy for classification-style tasks
reputation: A niche dataset for policy/rights-language parsing hosted on Hugging Face, with limited adoption beyond specialized policy-technology research.
